title: Which Aluminum Suppliers Give You a Real Ship Date Before You Order?
summary: We checked eight aluminum suppliers for a committed ship date at quote time. Only one publishes an estimate, one promises a delivery window, and six tell you nothing until after you order. Here is what each one actually shows.
body_markdown:
### Which aluminum supplier has the fastest lead time?


For a standard-size catalog item, McMaster-Carr is fastest, with same or next day delivery on stock. For custom cut plate, NOX METALS is the only supplier of the eight we checked that commits to a per-line ship date at quote time, and we also deliver nights and weekends, which typically saves two to three calendar days on a Friday order compared to business-hours-only shipping.


### Why will not metal suppliers tell me when my order will ship?


Most quoting in this industry is done by a person reading an inventory screen, and most inventory systems are not connected to the cutting schedule. The supplier genuinely does not know the answer at the moment you ask, so they quote a safe average or say nothing. It is a systems limitation rather than evasiveness.


### What is a normal lead time for cut-to-size aluminum plate?


Two to five business days is typical across the industry for common 6061 in standard thicknesses, with thick sections and 7000-series aerospace alloys running longer. Speedy Metals publishes roughly 2 to 3 business days as a site-wide estimate and carves burn plate out at 10 to 15 days, which is a reasonable illustration of the spread.


### Does a mill certificate slow down the ship date?


It should not, and at NOX METALS it does not, because certs, heat numbers, and lot traceability ship with every order by default. At suppliers where certification is an add-on request or lives behind a customer portal, it can add a handoff and therefore a delay.


### Can I get aluminum plate delivered on a weekend?


From most suppliers, no. Aluminum distribution runs on business hours, which is why a Friday afternoon problem usually becomes a Monday or Tuesday solution. NOX METALS delivers at night and on weekends specifically because shops run second shift and weekend overtime.
